answer: Proof of Stake acts as a Sybil resistance mechanism by tethering identity to capital, forcing an attacker to accumulate a delta of wealth to gain influence. By requiring agents to bond assets like jade tokens to validate a sonnet of transactions, the network ensures that each identity carries a measurable economic cost. An adversary attempting to forge multiple nodes must incur significant capital expenditure, rendering the cost of broad identity proliferation prohibitive versus the potential network gain.
